title: Five heating zones and circulation-fan placement in a roller-hearth furnace for bulldozer blades
summary: Suneng's roller-hearth quench-heating furnace proposal for bulldozer cutting edges, dated 17 October 2020, specifies five heating zones and three water-cooled circulation fans, one each in zones three, four and five in the middle-to-rear section. Circulation is arranged by position in the heating process; there is not a fan in every zone. For similar cutting edges, assess thickness, furnace transport and the rear equalising section together. Fan count alone cannot establish either insufficient provision or achieved temperature uniformity.
